parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, no documented facility exclusion, and a 2019 police guideline requiring detainees to be addressed by identified gender are positives. Hate-crime aggravation and hate speech protection covering gender identity exist on paper since 2017. Against this, the dossier reports that police continue to disregard hate-crime complaints and that attacks often go unpunished, so recourse is thin. Documented violence is dated (2001, 2009, 2014) and no later incident is recorded, so it is weak evidence of current frequency, but the 2009 kidnapping was unreported and the 2014 attack implicated a neo-Nazi group. Survey data is LGBT-wide and dated, so it carries little weight. Social ostracism is described as persisting. Visitor-facing border, document and facility rules are undocumented. Subnational conditions outside the capital are unknown. The rating sits in the elevated band: paper protections and a sound detention guideline, offset by unremedied hostility and weak enforcement.
